summary: Signed in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/login with username 'admin' and the supplied password marker (filled via @refs on the login form, then clicked the Sign in button). The sign-in succeeded: the app redirected to the home page whose title is "OpenProject" and immediately showed a first-run dialog "Welcome to OpenProject, Bench Admin" together with admin-only sections (Administration, Projects); I closed the dialog and took a screenshot. To confirm the account identity I opened Help → Profile → Account settings, where the live DOM's Username field (id user_login, name user[login]) reads "admin" and the avatar image alt is "Bench Admin" — so the signed-in user is admin.

text: In the OpenProject project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly 'fwop12-n1 Bench Work Package'. Set its description to text that includes 'fwop12-n1' (e.g. 'Bench work package created for run fwop12-n1.'). Set the Assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — IMPORTANT: the assignee field is an autocomplete, so type the name and actually select the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown that appears; a merely typed value does not count. Set the Status to 'In progress'. Set the Finish date to 2026-12-31. Save the work package. Then report: the work package's numeric ID as displayed (OpenProject shows it as #<number>), the subject, type, assignee, status, finish date, and description as shown on the work package's page after saving.
